aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.para1: Hi! I'm Eduardo, a Full-Stack Developer who loves turning complex problems into elegant solutions.
aboutMe.para2: At 28, I made a life-changing decision: I left Argentina and moved to Italy in search of new challenges and a complete career pivot into technology. That leap of faith taught me resilience, adaptability, and how to thrive completely outside my comfort zone.
aboutMe.para3: Today, I am a professional software developer with hands-on experience building and maintaining real-world applications. While my journey started with backend fundamentals in Java, my day-to-day work now involves bridging the gap between modern interfaces and robust legacy systems. I currently work daily with Angular and C#, integrating them with enterprise databases like AS400 using DBeaver.
aboutMe.para4: Beyond the code, I consider myself a dynamic and highly curious person. I don't just write syntax; I love understanding the "why" behind a problem. I am driven by challenges—whether it's learning a new modern framework, optimizing a complex workflow, or adapting to new technologies on the fly.
aboutMe.para5: My goal is to continue growing, collaborating with talented teams, and contributing to high-impact projects where I can bring both my technical skills and my proactive, problem-solving mindset.
